trumpRule: CODEX 48: chain-of-title is the record. Every fact shown here is a pipeline-written chain event. AI synthesizes — pipeline writes. CAS color on every status element. Risk score in 3 seconds before prose.

canvasTabs.label: Chain of Title
canvasTabs.description: Hero band: Risk Score (0-100, RED>50 / YELLOW 20-50 / GREEN<20) + Order ID + address + order type + status. Vertical timeline newest-first: each ownership transfer as a CAS-coded card (grantor→grantee, deed type, instrument no., recording date, amount, status: Verified/Gap/Review). Gaps in chain = RED banner. Right rail: current owner, APN, parcel map with subject parcel highlighted, last recorded price.

canvasTabs.label: Liens & Encumbrances
canvasTabs.description: Lien stack as horizontal bars (zero height = clear = GREEN). Rows: Mortgage / Tax / Judgment / HOA / Mechanic / IRS — each showing lender/authority, original amount, recording date, status (Open=YELLOW / Released=GREEN / Delinquent=RED). IRS lien = P0 defect auto-flagged in RED. Total lien exposure hero number top-right. Filter: All / Open / Released.

canvasTabs.label: Tax Status
canvasTabs.description: Tax year, annual tax amount, assessed value, market value from ATTOM pipeline event (title.tax_status_found). Delinquency flag: RED banner + year if delinquent (P1 defect). Exemptions on file. County assessor parcel link. Tax proration calculator (days to close → buyer/seller split).

canvasTabs.label: Defects
canvasTabs.description: Defect registry from title.defect_logged chain events. Color-severity chips: P0=RED (blocking — title failure), P1=YELLOW (curative required before close), P2=GREY (advisory/exception). Each defect card: severity badge, description, evidence event IDs, suggested cure, status (Open/Cured). P0 count = RED badge on tab. When 0 defects: GREEN 'Title search clean' hero. Action: Log defect (opens AI-assisted form).

canvasTabs.label: Order Summary
canvasTabs.description: Plain-English summary of the title search for the file. Buyer/Seller names. Purchase price + order type. Key dates. Risk score + narrative ('This title has 2 open liens and no ownership gaps. Recommend curative release before commitment.'). Export PDF button. Handoff buttons: 'Send to Commitment Engine' → re-commitment-001, 'Send to Defect Tracker' → re-defect-tracker-001. Chain event count summary.
